android.releaseNotes:
• WhatsApp/Instagram-Grade VoIP Calling: Enhanced signaling reliability, safe video room clearance, and audio routing controls.
• Apple-Grade Smoothness: Global iOS BouncingScrollPhysics with spring physics across feeds, lists, and drawers.
• Battery & Thermal Optimization Engine: Dynamic power manager reducing CPU/GPU overhead and pausing heavy shaders when idle or scrolling.
• Floating Call PiP: iOS FaceTime-style magnetic edge snapping and boundary clamping.
• Clean Architecture Refactor: Eliminated single-method usecase wrappers and redundant dependencies.
